stories.headline: Google plans $15 billion Finland AI buildout
stories.summary: Google will invest at least €13 billion ($15.1 billion) in Finnish AI infrastructure and signed its first nuclear-power contract outside the U.S. The investment and projected economic effects are company estimates.

stories.headline: OpenAI pushes AI into specialized industries
stories.summary: OpenAI is targeting chip design, life sciences and finance while experimenting with outcome-based pricing. Its CFO says company models helped complete a chip design in nine months; that performance claim is not independently benchmarked.

stories.headline: Qualcomm and Amazon strike major AI-chip deal
stories.summary: Amazon could buy up to $60 billion of Qualcomm AI data-center products under a long-term deal. Qualcomm granted purchase-linked warrants worth about $4 billion, underscoring intertwined financing in the AI boom.

stories.headline: US–Iran war escalates around Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran said it attacked a U.S.-used base in Jordan and 10 ships after the U.S. destroyed five Iranian tankers. Jordan reported intercepting 18 of 20 missiles with no casualties, disputing Iran's claim of heavy damage.

stories.headline: IAEA reports new North Korean enrichment site
stories.summary: The IAEA says satellite imagery and state-media photos indicate a new Yongbyon uranium-enrichment facility and expanded operations at Kangson. Inspectors have not been inside North Korea since 2009.
